text:
mei: quick alert from qbench-run on q4b-int3: we see a spike in dedupe collisions for prompt_gold_v2. looks like tokenizer remap + quantized kernel pruning collapsed several paraphrase clusters into identical fingerprints. tagging @labeling-team and @ops.
derek: can you paste a concrete pair? exact token-level collapse or hash collision after normalization?
mei: short pair: original: "Cancel my subscription for plan A" paraphrase: "I want to cancel plan A subscription" -> both produced the same fingerprint under fingerprint_v4 after int3 runtime. run snippet: ```python
# repro
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('runtime_tok_v1.json')
print(t.encode("Cancel my subscription for plan A").ids)
print(t.encode("I want to cancel plan A subscription").ids)
```
olivia: if the tokenizer changed subword split, fingerprint_v4 (which hashes token ids+anchors) will match. are we sure this is int3-only? any change log pointing at tokenizer merges?
mei: runtime release notes v1.4.2 mention a new subword merge optimization for int3 kernels. initial diffs match.
zach: how big is affected slice?
mei: qbench flagged ~6.2k conflicts across prompt_gold_v2 (total bank ~220k). of those, ~1.1k are anchors with golden labels.
labeling-bot: export queued: `export_prompts --set prompt_gold_v2 --filter "conflict=true" --out s3://redwood/q4b_int3_conflicts.json` (job 7891)
derek: we should avoid immediate full re-fingerprint. proposal: (A) run a micro-A/B on 8k sample slice comparing fingerprint_v4 vs fallback ngram-char(5) rolling hash, (B) run a targeted re-fingerprint only for anchors that changed, (C) put golden freeze window while we triage.
mei: +1. also add a dry-run re-fingerprint script so we can preview queue churn without mutating golden labels. i'll open PR with repro and scripts.
olivia: labeler ops note: if conflicts are resolved by re-fp many items will re-enter review. please estimate capacity impact.
zach: rough estimate: targeted re-fp -> ~2.5 hours on current pool; full bank ~5.5 hrs if parallel x3. labeler churn: expect ~300 tasks requeued during rescue wave; contractor lead okayed 2 extra reviewers for 4 hrs.
derek: governance: golden label edits MUST follow two-person approval + provenance tag. create a small checklist: 1) diff in git, 2) JIRA ticket linked, 3) 2 approvals, 4) backfill eval run.
mei: agreed. i'll add checklist to PR and set default to read-only for re-fp tool. ops-bot can you schedule an export + invite?
ops-bot: export job 7891 running. calendar event created: "q4b-int3 prompt-gold rescue" tomorrow 9:30-12:30 PT.
olivia: also run a quick sweep against int8 and fp16 builds to rule out broader tokenizer regressions. even if the log points to int3, good to be safe.
derek: metric targets for A/B: reduce false merges <1.5%, duplicate rate delta <0.25%, and eval delta on gold anchors <0.5% absolute accuracy drop.
mei: will run micro-A/B and push results in the PR. plan: PR by EOD, A/B job tomorrow morning, targeted re-fingerprint after A/B results, golden changes gated behind two approvals and backfill eval.
zach: thanks. one more ask: if we adopt ngram-char fallback, create a migration plan to recompute fingerprints with provenance tags so customers of prompt_bank snapshots can reproduce.
derek: noted. add migration script to repo and include provenance fields: {migration_version, source_tokenizer, fingerprint_algo}.
mei: will include those fields in PR metadata. updating thread as I push PR & A/B logs.
olivia: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
derek: appreciate the quick ops coordination. we'll keep this thread as the single-point update.
labeling-bot: reminder: do not mutate golden labels until two approvals present.
